'''Gal-Stod Slagistrough''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]], and a leading member of the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Jedi Service Corps]] branch, the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]], during the years proceeding the implementation of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Among his contributions to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during his years of service with the AgriCorps was his authorship of a chapter of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] guidebook titled, ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. Jedi Slagistrough detailed the inner workings of the Service Corps and its connection with the [[Council of Reassignment/Legends|Council of Reassignment]], helping to prepare [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] for a possible assignment to the life of a service worker.

==Biography==
When it came time for Initiate Slagistrough to take his [[Initiate Trials/Legends|final trials]] to graduate from the [[Jedi academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he attempted and failed to pass the tests presented to him and was reassigned to serve in the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]]. Working his way up in the Corps, Slagistrough was eventually appointed to the [[Council of AgriCorps Masters]]. Unlike most Jedi of the era, Jedi Slagistrough did not serve in the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] in the crusades against the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. Instead, Slagistrough continued to maintain order within the Service Corps, aiding worlds devastated by the [[New Sith Wars]] and providing food for soldiers on the front lines. When his brother and sister Jedi within the Order proposed that a guidebook to the life of the Jedi be written, Jedi Slagistrough agreed to work on the project, contributing a chapter describing the inner workings of the Service Corps.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
While it did not make it into the finished edition, [[Daniel Wallace]], author of [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], released a list detailing the genders and species of each of the authors of the in-universe ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. Master Slagistrough is revealed to be a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]].<ref name="JCF" />
